title: Daily Workout · November 2
note: Moderate restart after several days away. Only do this workout if headache and post-vaccination symptoms have resolved and energy is normal. Walk instead of jog if needed. Stop for chest discomfort, dizziness, unusual palpitations or breathlessness.

items.name: Lying quad stretch
items.instructions: Lie on your side, draw your heel toward your glutes without forcing.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit upright, soles together, knees relaxed.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Rotate gently without forcing the low back.

items.name: Plow Pose (Halasana)
items.instructions: Use only comfortable range, no force on neck. Skip if neck or back discomfort.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Walk comfortably to warm up.

items.name: Jog interval
items.instructions: Jog at conversational effort; switch to brisk walking if needed.

items.name: Recovery walk
items.instructions: Recover at an easy walking pace.

items.name: Incline walk
items.instructions: Walk uphill steadily, keeping effort moderate.

items.name: Cool-down
items.instructions: Gradually lower pace and breathe normally.

items.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlifts
items.instructions: Use manageable dumbbells, e.g. 15–20 lb each if comfortable; hinge at hips and maintain neutral spine.

items.name: Weighted glute bridges
items.instructions: Secure a padded dumbbell across hips, squeeze at top for two seconds without arching.

items.name: Resistance-band lateral steps
items.instructions: Keep knees slightly bent and band under tension.

items.name: Side planks
items.detail: 3 min · 2 × 30 sec each side, with rest
items.instructions: Keep hips lifted and torso aligned.

items.name: Suitcase carries
items.detail: 3 min · 2 × 30 sec each side, with rest
items.instructions: Hold one dumbbell and walk upright without leaning.

items.name: Bent-knee leg raises
items.instructions: Lower slowly without arching the back.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Extend opposite arm and leg slowly while maintaining trunk control.
